from: From the summit, downclimb the last ~100 ft of Class 2-3 terrain, then reverse the roped pitch above the chimney and rappel the 5.8 chimney/headwall (3 rappels total) to regain the upper gully. From there, descend an east-facing snow couloir for roughly 1,400 vertical feet using snow flukes and running belays back to the south col at ~7,480 ft, then reverse the traverse and ridge pitches back toward Icy-Spruce Pass camp — a round trip reported at roughly 19-20 hours from high camp on one ascent.
to: From the summit, downclimb the last ~100 ft of Class 2-3 terrain, then reverse the roped pitch above the chimney and rappel the 5.8 chimney/headwall (3 rappels total) to regain the upper gully. From there, descend an east-facing snow couloir for roughly 1,400 vertical feet using snow flukes and running belays back to the south col at ~7,480 ft, then reverse the traverse and ridge pitches back toward Icy-Spruce Pass camp. The round trip from high camp takes about 15-16 hours for a typical party and close to 20 for a slow one.
